items.title: Create formal stash split execution plan document
items.context: Document the executable split plan for stash@{0}, including buckets, restore mechanics, stop conditions, tests, and non-goals. The document must avoid broad optimization and only authorize real correctness fixes.
items.userSees: User sees docs/requirements/decisions/stash-split-execution-plan.md with bucketed stash handling, restore mechanics, stop conditions, tests, and non-goals.

happy.desc: Document defines executable buckets for stash@{0}: runtime path cleanup, smoke expectation repairs, Layer4 doc, planner hash deferral, and dev-memory data exclusion.

edge.desc: Document explicitly handles untracked stash restore mechanics, including Layer4 doc from stash untracked parent and no default restore for .lattice/dev-memory/experience.jsonl.

adversarial.desc: Document forbids whole stash pop, mixed commits, arbitrary planner hash churn, and committing local dev-memory data without explicit versioning decision.

verificationEvidence.command: node inline Bucket A / NAV restore correctness checker
verificationEvidence.note: Bucket A no longer scopes .gitignore or requires git check-ignore; dev-memory data is excluded by not restoring, staging, or committing it.
Focused doc patch has no whitespace errors and only corrects the two reviewer-verified execution-plan issues.

items.title: Update requirements navigation for the new decision
items.context: Add the new decision document to docs/requirements/NAV.md and keep the decision count mechanically consistent with the current decisions directory.
items.userSees: User sees docs/requirements/NAV.md count and decision links updated to include the new stash split execution plan decision.

happy.desc: NAV count matches the number of Markdown files under docs/requirements/decisions after adding stash-split-execution-plan.md.

edge.desc: NAV update preserves existing Layer 2, Layer 3, and Root Document Migration Guide entries while adding only the new stash split decision.

adversarial.desc: NAV must not apply the stale stash Layer4 patch or claim Layer4 document has been added by this story.

verificationEvidence.note: Current NAV has 37 decision links for 37 decision files and preserves Layer2, Layer3, Root Document Migration Guide, and Stash Split Execution Plan entries.

verificationEvidence.command: node inline stale NAV restore guard checker
verificationEvidence.note: Plan now forbids restoring docs/requirements/NAV.md from stash@{0}; future Layer4 work must hand-merge the NAV link and count from current state.

items.title: Verify the document against current stash and navigation state
items.context: Run mechanical checks that the plan references the actual stash@{0} groups, does not claim execution, does not authorize whole stash pop, and keeps Layer4/NAV guidance current.
items.userSees: User sees validation evidence showing the document matches current stash@{0}, avoids stash execution, and keeps NAV mechanically consistent.

happy.desc: Mechanical check confirms document mentions every current stash@{0} path group and the current stash still exists.

edge.desc: Mechanical check confirms the document says NAV must be reconciled against current main and count 37 for this story, rather than reusing stale stash NAV text.

adversarial.desc: Mechanical check confirms the document does not say to run git stash pop and does not claim the stash content was executed or merged.

verificationEvidence.command: git stash show --name-only --include-untracked stash@{0} + node inline checker
verificationEvidence.note: Current stash@{0} still exists with the same 12 paths; plan still inventories each path group and restores untracked Layer4 doc only from stash@{0}^3.

verificationEvidence.command: Claude-host read-only audit + node inline NAV checker
verificationEvidence.note: Independent read-only audit confirmed stashed NAV is stale and current plan requires hand-merge from current NAV rather than path restore.
Plan forbids stash pop, whole-stash apply, whole-tree restore, dev-memory data commit, and stale NAV path restore.
